newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chairman ups China Strategic shares offer.
newsitem.headline: Chairman ups China Strategic shares offer.

text.p: China Strategic Holdings Ltd chairman Oei Hong Leong has raised his offer for all shares in the company to HK$2.80 per share from HK$2.50, the company said in a statement on Monday.

Oei was required to raise his offer for the company's shares after he bought a further 4.996 million shares or 0.76 percent of the company at HK$2.80 per share on Friday, raising his stake to 244.81 million shares or 37.06 percent, it said.
In October, Oei had announced a general offer for shares of China Strategic at HK$2.50 each.
The offer for the outstanding company warrants will be unchanged at HK$0.29 each, it said.
